gnomad.selection: One row per gene: Ensembl MANE Select, then Ensembl canonical, then MANE/canonical, then Ensembl protein-coding/longest CDS.

iuis.normalization: Composite entries split; known legacy aliases converted to current VEP-compatible symbols; cytogenetic and unknown entries retained with a blank gene_symbol.

haploinsufficiency.source: Manually curated IEI haploinsufficiency gene list from IUIS 2024
